notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell this turn.
description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Colfenor's Plans and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Colfenor's Plans prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.
